description: This Java class implements a notification channel for Microsoft Teams within the Thingsboard platform, handling both adaptive and message cards, constructing payloads, and sending HTTP POST requests to configured webhooks.

classes.name: MicrosoftTeamsNotificationChannel
classes.description: Implements a notification channel for Microsoft Teams, capable of sending adaptive and message cards via webhooks, with URL validation and template processing.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to Microsoft Teams using the specified target configuration and template, choosing between old API and adaptive card based on configuration.

methods.name: sendTeamsAdaptiveCard
methods.description: Constructs and sends an adaptive card payload to Microsoft Teams webhook.

methods.name: sendTeamsMessageCard
methods.description: Constructs and sends a message card payload to Microsoft Teams webhook.

methods.name: getButtonUri
methods.description: Generates the URI for the notification button, handling dashboard link construction with optional state encoding.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs any necessary checks for tenant-specific configuration (empty implementation).

methods.name: getDeliveryMethod
methods.description: Returns the notification delivery method type, MICROSOFT_TEAMS.
